full_page.content:
1947, March 12
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
March 12th '47.
Joseph J. O'Donnell 1120 Lake Shore Drive Chicago, Illinois.
St. Felix Capuchin Monastery, Huntington, Ind .- 2
Thanks be to God for Everything.
God bless you J.J. and Win. I'd write at length .. but I just want to thank you for favor of the 8th. Thank God for M.C's change !! He could not have received my letter befor Monday. - sent Friday on 3¢. It only heightens my hopes in God's designs .... How wonderful! .... Brother Pat. has snapped out of dange. . Deo Gr.
God love you all. Sincerely yours in +o Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
